name: Thin Pixel-7 GB Compact
status: approved third-party font; installed by default in the English ROM

design.source: Thin Pixel-7 version 1.0 by Sizenko Alexander / Style-7
design.fit: Thin Pixel-7's exact 20ppem binary letter and punctuation pixels, with playtest-reviewed comma, question-mark, colon, plus, minus and compact percent refinements; g/p/q/y retain their normal lowercase baseline and complete two-row tails while one repeated bowl/stem row is omitted; one repeated lowercase-j stem row is removed to fit 8px. Numerals use playtest-reviewed compact drawings with uniform 5px tabular advances.
design.license: Bundled EULA permits use in freeware software with credit; commercial or business use requires a separate license. See licenses/Thin-Pixel-7.txt.
design.credit: Thin Pixel-7 by Sizenko Alexander (Style-7), adapted to the Game Boy cell for the Shiren GB English patch.

source.name: Thin Pixel-7 GB Compact 8x8 glyph rows
source.provenance: Generated from the upstream Thin Pixel-7 20ppem binary strike, with the project-reviewed digit and symbol adaptations declared in design.fit. The third-party TTF is not redistributed; the adapted raster rows and required attribution are retained here.
